content.name: Ring of Invisibility
entries: While wearing this ring, you can turn {@condition invisible} as an action. Anything you are wearing or carrying is {@condition invisible} with you. You remain {@condition invisible} until the ring is removed, until you attack or cast a spell, or until you use a bonus action to become visible again.

content.name: Ring of Invisibility
entries: While wearing this ring, you can take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to give yourself the {@condition Invisible|SRD52} condition. You remain {@condition Invisible|SRD52} until the ring is removed or until you take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|SRD52} to become visible again.
